configuration.cacheLifecycle: Fresh synthetic store per requested mode, authored query order in both passes; no hidden warmup/retry
configuration.fixedClock: Distinct second per canonical v1 write; graph 01:00:00, 01:00:01, correction 01:00:02 UTC on 2026-01-01
configuration.modelAssets: deliberately absent; measures literal and honest no-model fallback
configuration.timingScope: Search/graph domain calls exclude fixture setup and full-read verification. denied_write includes before/after backup snapshots and receipt verification. Expected denial latency is reported separately by category; failures cannot satisfy a latency gate.

animaAnswerAndToolUse.reason: Separate model/harness evaluation required; no model calls or host changes authorized in this slice

captureQuality.reason: Harness intelligence selects memories; this fixture preloads only selected synthetic records

learnedRetrieval.reason: Deterministic learned-index scheduling and real-model qualification are a separate slice; no local assets loaded

temporalGraph.scope: Structured contract recall only; no natural-language planner

v1Retrieval.transport: Direct native domain API used by MCP; not a host/IPC test

metricDefinitions.allEvidence: All positive qrels must be present; each is required, not an alternative
metricDefinitions.emptyQrels: Ranking null; separate retrieval-empty expectation, not model abstention
metricDefinitions.holdout: Public regression holdout by scenario, not a secret test or statistical generalization claim
metricDefinitions.mrr: Reciprocal first relevant rank at k; duplicates consume slots
metricDefinitions.precision: Unique relevant hits divided by fixed k=5, including short result lists
metricDefinitions.ranking: Macro average over successfully scored answerable cases only; attempted/scored/errors disclosed. No cross-mode or cross-pass average.
metricDefinitions.recall: Unique relevant hits at k divided by all positive qrels

provenance.sourceManifestScope: Selected compiled modules and lockfile only, not an exhaustive source/build manifest. Executable SHA identifies the actual evaluated binary.
